microtheory.name: evolution_theory
microtheory.definition: Evolution as the unifying theory of biology. Natural selection, drift, mutation, recombination, speciation, evo-devo, major transitions. Modern synthesis + extended evolutionary synthesis. Substrate analogue: the substrate's adaptive dynamics — Mts under selection pressure from coherence-drive + curiosity-drive.

concepts.name: darwinian_natural_selection
concepts.definition: Darwin 1859. Three conditions: heritable variation + differential reproduction + correlation with traits. Substrate analogue: substrate's covers_correction differential strengthening.

concepts.name: mutation
concepts.definition: Random change in DNA. Source of new variation. Substrate analogue: substrate's stochastic Mt modifications.

concepts.name: recombination_genetic
concepts.definition: Mixing of alleles during meiosis. Source of variation in sexual reproduction. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-combination via shared concepts.

concepts.name: gene_flow
concepts.definition: Transfer of alleles between populations via migration. Substrate analogue: substrate-substrate Mt transfer.

concepts.name: founder_effect
concepts.definition: Small founding population establishes new gene-frequency baseline. Substrate analogue: substrate's seed Mts setting baseline.

concepts.name: bottleneck_effect
concepts.definition: Population reduction causes random allele frequency change. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-loss during pruning.

concepts.name: modern_synthesis
concepts.definition: 1920s-40s integration of Darwinism + Mendelism + population genetics. Dobzhansky, Mayr, Simpson. Substrate analogue: substrate's integrated adaptation theory.

concepts.name: extended_evolutionary_synthesis
concepts.definition: Laland 2015. Adds developmental bias, niche construction, inclusive inheritance, evolvability. Substrate analogue: substrate's multi-mechanism adaptation.

concepts.name: neutral_theory
concepts.definition: Kimura 1968. Most molecular variation is selectively neutral. Drift dominant at molecular level. Substrate analogue: substrate's non-selected drift.

concepts.name: speciation_modes
concepts.definition: Allopatric (geographic isolation), sympatric (same area), parapatric. Mayr's biological species concept. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-divergence types.

concepts.name: reproductive_isolation
concepts.definition: Mechanisms preventing interbreeding. Prezygotic + postzygotic barriers. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-incompatibility.

concepts.name: punctuated_equilibrium
concepts.definition: Gould + Eldredge 1972. Long stasis + brief speciation bursts. Substrate analogue: substrate's phase-transition dynamics.

concepts.name: evo_devo
concepts.definition: Evolutionary developmental biology. Hox genes, body plan conservation, modularity. Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational + variable structure separation.

concepts.name: hox_genes
concepts.definition: Homeobox genes specifying body plan. Conserved across animals. Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational Mt structure shared across instances.

concepts.name: modularity
concepts.definition: Independence of evolution between different body regions. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-Mt independent evolution.

concepts.name: kin_selection
concepts.definition: Hamilton 1964. Genes favoring helping relatives spread because they're shared. Inclusive fitness. Substrate analogue: substrate's coverage spreading via shared concepts.

concepts.name: inclusive_fitness
concepts.definition: Own + helped-relatives' reproductive success weighted by relatedness. Substrate analogue: substrate's extended-coverage measure.

concepts.name: group_selection
concepts.definition: Wilson + Wilson 2007. Selection between groups. Controversial. Substrate analogue: in multi-substrate contexts, between-substrate selection.

concepts.name: reciprocal_altruism
concepts.definition: Trivers 1971. Helping others who later help back. Substrate analogue: substrate-substrate exchange of FilterSpecs.

concepts.name: evolutionarily_stable_strategy
concepts.definition: Maynard Smith 1973. Strategy that resists invasion by alternatives. Game-theoretic equilibrium. Substrate analogue: substrate's stable Mt configuration.

concepts.name: major_transitions_evolution
concepts.definition: Maynard Smith + Szathmáry 1995. Major shifts in how info stored + transmitted: single→multicellular, asexual→sexual, primate→human (language). Substrate analogue: substrate's architectural phase transitions.

concepts.name: cultural_evolution
concepts.definition: Selection on cultural variants (memes). Boyd + Richerson. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-spread across substrate instances.

concepts.name: memetic_evolution
concepts.definition: Dawkins 1976. Memes as cultural replicators analogous to genes. Substrate analogue: substrate's Concept spread + selection.

concepts.name: evolutionary_developmental_constraint
concepts.definition: Some phenotypes harder to evolve due to developmental architecture. Substrate analogue: substrate's path-dependent capability space.

concepts.name: adaptive_radiation
concepts.definition: Rapid diversification after new niche opens. Darwin's finches. Substrate analogue: substrate's Mt-explosion after seed change.

concepts.name: convergent_evolution
concepts.definition: Similar traits evolving independently. Wings in birds + bats + insects. Substrate analogue: substrate's parallel-arrival at similar solutions.

concepts.name: vestigial_structure
concepts.definition: Reduced structure from ancestor's full version. Whale pelvic bones. Substrate analogue: substrate's residual unused Mts.

rules.name: selection_requires_three_conditions
rules.head: the substrate exhibits adaptive change over generations
rules.body: Darwin's three conditions must hold: heritable variation + differential reproduction + correlation between trait + reproduction. Substrate's correction-firing model.

rules.name: drift_dominates_at_low_selection_strength
rules.head: selection coefficient is small relative to population size
rules.body: drift dominates. Neutral changes accumulate. Kimura. Substrate's weakly-selected Mt changes.

rules.name: inclusive_fitness_explains_altruism
rules.head: the substrate helps related individuals at cost to self
rules.body: Hamilton's rule: br > c. Benefit × relatedness > cost. Substrate's shared-coverage benefit.

rules.name: evo_devo_constrains_what_can_evolve
rules.head: the substrate's developmental machinery has bias
rules.body: some phenotypes are easier to evolve than others. Path dependency. Substrate's capability-space constraint.

rules.name: punctuated_equilibrium_predicts_stasis_then_change
rules.head: the substrate has long periods of stable Mt structure
rules.body: change concentrates in brief bursts at speciation events. Gould + Eldredge. Substrate's phase-transition dynamic.
